name: STAR Kidz AI Contact Finder (Apollo → mail ids & phones)

parameters.content:
## STAR Kidz AI Contact Finder — setup

1. Paste your **Apollo.io API key** into BOTH HTTP nodes (header `x-api-key`) — same key as the discovery workflow.
2. **Activate** the workflow, copy the Webhook **Production URL**.
3. Paste it in the dashboard: **🤖 Lead-Gen AI Agent → ⚙️ Agent Settings → 🧠 contact-finder webhook URL**.
4. In the dashboard press **⚡ Find mail & phone for ALL leads missing contacts** (or 🔎 AI find on one lead). The dashboard POSTs `{event:'find_contacts', leads:[{id,name,city,state,country,...}]}`; this workflow looks up each firm on Apollo (company phone + website, then a decision-maker with email) and returns `[{id,email,phone,person,website}]` — the dashboard fills the pipeline automatically.

⚠️ Apollo notes: personal emails may come back as `email_not_unlocked@...` on the free plan — unlocking costs credits. Company phone numbers & websites are usually free. ~2 API calls per lead, so enrich in small batches on the free tier.
